headline: 1,535 hospitalised as 3 more die of dengue in 24 hours
summary: The Directorate General of Health Services (DGHS) reports a surge in cases, with the total death toll now reaching 455.
details: At least three dengue patients died and 1,535 others were hospitalised in the 24 hours leading up to 8:00 am today, according to the Directorate General of Health Services (DGHS).
The deaths occurred in the Dhaka and Khulna divisions, with two reported in Dhaka and one in Khulna.
With these latest fatalities, the total death toll from dengue has risen to 455, while the cumulative number of cases has reached 145,906.
Currently, 5,773 dengue patients are undergoing treatment in hospitals across the country.

headline_marked: Attack in Chandpur: [[July uprising martyrs’ memorial torched]] by miscreants
headline: Attack in Chandpur: July uprising martyrs’ memorial torched by miscreants
summary: The incident occurred on November 6 during Friday prayers, when the memorial was set on fire in Chandpur town.
details: Miscreants set fire to the July uprising martyrs’ memorial in Chandpur town on November 6.
The attack took place during the afternoon, while most people were busy attending Friday prayers.
The memorial, which honors the martyrs of the July uprising, was targeted and torched by unidentified individuals.
The incident has caused significant damage to the structure of the memorial.
caption:
